submission.justification: Mixture-G2 at 2.0 mm gap provides the best time resolution (0.86 ns) among all tested configurations. It is compatible with the existing HV and recirculation systems, available in required quantities, and falls within the required gap size. Environmental and safety policies are satisfied by the planned 90% gas recovery and no additional risks for this mixture are documented. This option maximizes detector performance while meeting all constraints.
